verdict.rationale: Kling's own marketing says users can "generate multiple versions at once," "batch-produce videos," and automate production (kling-docs-7). It also describes Skills generating assets in parallel (kling-docs-4) and an MCP/CLI to drive generation "at scale" (kling-docs-8). All of this is homepage copy, so the depth of the bulk tooling is unproven. Missing for 10: technical documentation of batch/bulk API endpoints or CLI commands, bulk operations beyond generation (e.g., managing, editing or exporting many assets at once), stated limits on batch size, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
